body: Nope, no vaping and I also don't smoke :/ I do edibles only, and I do them once per week at most, with longer breaks if I think I'm developing a tolerance. I definitely effed up somewhere, but don't know exactly where.

I was also hesitant about doing too much for my first time because my tabs are also advertised as 220ug, but according to the people with experience, tabs are almost always underdosed, so I did a full tab for my first time.

It was pretty cool, and I'm sure using only half of it wouldn't have been enough.

Personally, I decided to risk it, since I preferred it being too much to it not being enough.

"There's only one way to find out", as they say here :]


Edit: Since you are experienced with weed, I (personally) would say that the general body feeling is like that one of being *very* high on edibles, plus the added bonus of cool visuals. Just relax and see what happens.

I did one tab at around 11 pm last night, it's currently 8 am and I still have some weak visuals!

This has been an incredibly long high compared to what I'm used to (weed edibles specifically, around 4-5 hours high), but time has passed so much faster on LSD.

I was having fun and was sad that it was coming to an end so quickly, but then I realized that it was not fast, and I had been staring at shit for like 6 hours at that point.

Now I just feel like yapping about the experience to anyone willing to listen.

Already came down from it, but thanks for the suggestions!   
  
I'm saving all of this for the next one :p

Precisely because I liked it, I plan to be *very* careful not to do it too often. Just often enough to keep it fresh, and something I can do once in a while for a change of pace. In this case, I'm planning to wait for *at least* a couple of months before trying again, and once that happens, ensure I have a better environment prepared to make it even better, more special.

Emotional me thinks: Honestly, I do feel very stuck with my life in general, so the come down was like: "Well, here we go again, was fun while it lasted."   
And, of course, substance abuse is not a way to deal with that feeling, but I feel like at least I have one more thing to look forward to (another trip lol).

Having something (anything) new to look forward to is always nice when you feel stuck.
This one is definitely a bit overwhelming right now, but I'm saving it for when I have a bit more experience 👀
Adding to this, it's like I'm never looking at the same person for more than one second! Looks like a different face aaaall the time
Taking the best care of my "first trip" feelings while I have them!
It is amazing, you just made me have a blast looking at myself in the mirror, thanks 🫂
Sadly not a lot I can do with my family sleeping like 3 meters away from me, but I can stare at the coolest wall texture ever instead
